Launches three tracking missiles that divide among dangerous targets.
Adds missiles to the salvo over multiple levels.
Launches three area-damage shells toward dense alien formations.

Detonates early when several aliens enter the blast area.

Suggested values are planning targets and remain fully editable. Your Tech Tree sheet remains the source for branch order and names.
Allows the cannon to rotate with the right stick instead of firing only straight upward.
Direct fire toward edge targets and moving alien formations.
Projects a dotted line from the cannon so the player can see the exact firing direction.
Makes angled shots easier to place without adding automatic targeting.
Extends the aiming guide farther into the sky.
Improves long-range accuracy and makes distant edge targets easier to line up.
Adds a lead marker showing where the selected alien will be when the shell arrives.
Helps hit fast lateral targets without turning the base cannon into an automatic weapon.
Increases the damage dealt by each ordinary cannon shell.
Improves the cannon against tougher mid-wave ships.
Adds another direct-damage increase for late waves.
Heavy shells burst on impact and damage aliens close to the primary target.
Suggested: full damage to the target and 40% damage in a small radius.
Shortens the delay between ordinary cannon shots.
Improves firing rate from about 2.9 to 3.4 shots per second.
Further shortens the cannon reload cycle.
Reduces shot interval from 0.295 to 0.250 seconds.
Improves sustained damage against larger waves.
Reduces shot interval from 0.250 to 0.205 seconds.
Pushes manual firing closer to the current reload cap.
The cannon automatically fires while the trigger is held and a valid target is near the aim line.
Maintains the normal heat limit; it does not provide automatic aiming.
Reduces heat generated per shot and improves passive heat dissipation.
Extends the number of shots possible before overheating.
Reduces heat per shot from 0.23 to 0.21.
Adds another heat reduction and faster recovery.
Provides late-game cooling for rapid-fire builds.
Suggested heat per shot: 0.17 with stronger passive cooling.
Vents the weapon rapidly after it reaches maximum heat.
Suggested: one-second emergency vent followed by a brief cooling boost.
Improves debris collection and edge defense.
Improves late-wave repositioning without making the turret uncontrollable.
Accelerates quickly toward full speed and slows precisely near debris or screen edges.
Suggested: faster acceleration plus a short directional dash.
Spends debris to restore damaged Base Integrity.
Restores 120 integrity per purchase, up to the maximum.
Deploys drones that slowly repair the base between waves.
Suggested: restore 20 integrity during each wave break.
Reinforces the base with recovered alien armor.
Suggested: increase maximum integrity and reduce collision damage by 15%.
Creates a temporary shield that reflects alien projectiles back into the sky.
Suggested: activates automatically at low integrity with a long cooldown.
Uses the artifact's energy to protect the base from a lethal strike.
Suggested: once per wave, prevent destruction and leave the base at 1 integrity.
Launches three guided missiles that divide among dangerous targets.
Each missile deals 72 damage and tracks independently.
Adds missiles to the homing salvo as the relic is upgraded.
Progresses toward a maximum seven-missile salvo.
Improves target assignment so missiles spread intelligently across priority threats.
Bosses remain the first priority; extra missiles seek separate ships.
Each missile releases smaller bomblets when it reaches its target.
Suggested: three bomblets dealing 30% missile damage in a small radius.
Reserved for the final homing specialization.
Possible direction: missiles loop back for a second pass if their target dies.
Fires three flak shells toward the densest alien groups.
Each shell detonates for area damage; spread targeting avoids wasting all shells.
Improves swarm clearing without strongly increasing boss damage.
Detonates when enough aliens enter the blast area instead of only at a fixed point.
Makes the weapon more reliable against moving formations.
Each flak explosion releases secondary shrapnel bursts.
Suggested: four fragments seek nearby ships for reduced damage.
Reserved for the final flak specialization.
Possible direction: lingering debris cloud damages ships that pass through it.
Damages and nearly freezes every alien currently onscreen.
Deals 30 damage and heavily slows ships for 2.4 seconds.
Increases EMP damage and disruption duration.
Raises the effect to roughly 48 damage and 2.95 seconds.
EMP-disrupted ships take additional damage from all weapons.
Suggested vulnerability: 25% bonus damage while disrupted.
Keeps affected ships nearly frozen for longer.
Suggested: add 1.5 seconds without increasing screen-wide damage.
Reserved for the final EMP specialization.
Possible direction: destroyed disabled ships chain a smaller EMP to nearby ships.
Fires a vertical beam that pierces every alien above the turret.
Deals 170 damage across a 52-pixel-wide firing lane.
Widens the beam and increases its damage.
Fires a weaker second beam shortly after the first.
Suggested echo damage: 55% of the initial beam.
Adds additional delayed pulses along the same firing lane.
Suggested: two follow-up pulses at 40% damage each.
Reserved for the final Railgun specialization.
Possible direction: beam width narrows but damage rises sharply against bosses.
